guide.title: A week in Salt Lake City
guide.author: Nate Bird
guide.summary: Seven days of mountain trails, pioneer history, mole and fry sauce, and a day out on the Great Salt Lake, with the Wasatch always in view.

places.name: Kimpton Hotel Monaco Salt Lake City
places.address: 15 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: A 1924 bank building turned playful hotel, a block from the light rail and the Gateway.

places.name: The Grand America Hotel
places.address: 555 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
places.notes: The splurge. Marble, gardens and a proper afternoon tea, and an easy drive up to the canyons.

places.name: Little America Hotel
places.address: 500 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: The Grand America's friendlier sibling across the street, with big rooms and a big pool.

places.name: Inn on the Hill
places.address: 225 N State St, Salt Lake City, UT 84103
places.notes: A 1906 mansion turned bed and breakfast below the Capitol, with valley views and a cooked breakfast.

places.name: Red Iguana
places.address: 736 W North Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84116
places.notes: Seven kinds of mole and a line out the door since 1985. Ask for the mole sampler.

places.name: The Copper Onion
places.address: 111 E Broadway, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
places.notes: Seasonal American cooking downtown. The ricotta dumplings and the burger are the regulars' picks.

places.name: Takashi
places.address: 18 W Market St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: The city's best-loved sushi bar. No reservations, so come early.

places.name: Market Street Grill
places.address: 48 W Market St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: Oysters and fresh fish flown in daily, in a room that hasn't changed much since 1980.

places.name: Lucky 13 Bar and Grill
places.address: 135 W 1300 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84115
places.notes: Huge burgers with house-smoked bacon. Bring an appetite and a 21-plus ID.

places.name: Ruth's Diner
places.address: 4160 Emigration Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT 84108
places.notes: Breakfast in a trolley car up Emigration Canyon. Order the mile-high biscuits.

places.name: Caputo's Market & Deli
places.address: 314 W 300 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: Italian deli and a famous chocolate room. Grab sandwiches for a picnic.

places.name: Feldman's Deli
places.address: 2005 E 2700 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84109
places.notes: A New Jersey-style Jewish deli. Pastrami on rye and a black-and-white cookie.

places.name: Laziz Kitchen
places.address: 912 S Jefferson St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: Lebanese small plates and fresh hummus, in the small Central Ninth neighborhood.

places.name: HSL
places.address: 418 E 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
places.notes: Thoughtful seasonal dinners in a warm, wood-lined room. Book a table on a weekend.

places.name: Eva's Bakery
places.address: 155 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
places.notes: French pastries and good coffee on Main Street. Easy breakfast before Temple Square.

places.name: Tulie Bakery
places.address: 863 E 700 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84102
places.notes: A neighborhood bakery known for its croissants and seasonal fruit tarts.

places.name: Publik Coffee Roasters
places.address: 975 S West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: A big, bright roastery with good toast. A fine place to plan the day.

places.name: Squatters Pub Brewery
places.address: 147 W Broadway, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: Salt Lake's original brewpub, open since 1989. Try the Emigration Amber.

places.name: Beer Bar
places.address: 161 E 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
places.notes: Long tables, bratwurst and Belgian frites, with a deep list of local and imported beer.

places.name: Water Witch
places.address: 163 W 900 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: A tiny cocktail bar with no menu. Tell them what you like and they'll make it.

places.name: Temple Square
places.address: 50 N West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84150
places.notes: The heart of the city since 1847. Walk the gardens and hear the Tabernacle organ at noon.

places.name: Beehive House
places.address: 67 E South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
places.notes: Brigham Young's 1854 home, with free guided tours of the family rooms.

places.name: Utah State Capitol
places.address: 350 State St, Salt Lake City, UT 84103
places.notes: Free tours of a grand 1916 capitol, and a sweeping view of the valley from the steps.

places.name: Cathedral of the Madeleine
places.address: 331 E South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
places.notes: A 1909 cathedral with painted walls and stained glass. Free choir concerts in season.

places.name: Natural History Museum of Utah
places.address: 301 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108
places.notes: A wall of dinosaurs and great Native American galleries, in a building set into the foothills.

places.name: Utah Museum of Fine Arts
places.address: 410 Campus Center Dr, Salt Lake City, UT 84112
places.notes: A broad collection on the University of Utah campus, with strong Western American galleries.

places.name: The Leonardo
places.address: 209 E 500 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
places.notes: Science, art and tinkering under one roof, in the old city library. Good on a rainy day.

places.name: Clark Planetarium
places.address: 110 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
places.notes: Free exhibits and a dome theater at the Gateway. The Foucault pendulum is mesmerizing.

places.name: Salt Lake City Public Library
places.address: 210 E 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
places.notes: A curving glass library with a rooftop garden. Climb the walkway for views of the mountains.

places.name: Gilgal Sculpture Garden
places.address: 749 E 500 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84102
places.notes: A strange little garden of stone sculptures, including a sphinx with Joseph Smith's face.

places.name: Tracy Aviary
places.address: 589 E 1300 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84105
places.notes: Hundreds of birds inside Liberty Park, from bald eagles to flamingos.

places.name: This Is The Place Heritage Park
places.address: 2601 Sunnyside Ave S, Salt Lake City, UT 84108
places.notes: A living history village where Brigham Young first saw the valley in 1847.

places.name: Utah's Hogle Zoo
places.address: 2600 Sunnyside Ave S, Salt Lake City, UT 84108
places.notes: A hillside zoo across from the heritage park. Polar bears and a fine African savanna.

places.name: Red Butte Garden
places.address: 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108
places.notes: Botanic gardens and trails in the foothills, with summer concerts in the amphitheater.

places.name: Liberty Park
places.address: 600 E 900 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84105
places.notes: The city's big central park, with a pond, paddle boats and a long walking loop.

places.name: Memory Grove Park
places.address: 300 N Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT 84103
places.notes: A quiet green ravine below the Capitol, leading up into City Creek Canyon.

places.name: Ensign Peak Trailhead
places.address: Ensign Vista Dr, Salt Lake City, UT 84103
places.notes: A short, steep climb to the best view of the city. Go at sunset.

places.name: Sugar House Park
places.address: 1330 E 2100 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84106
places.notes: Rolling lawns and a pond with mountain views. Pair it with lunch in Sugar House.

places.name: Donut Falls Trailhead
places.address: Big Cottonwood Canyon Rd, Brighton, UT 84121
places.notes: An easy canyon hike to a waterfall that pours through a hole in the rock. Best in summer.

places.name: Antelope Island State Park
places.address: 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075
places.notes: A causeway out into the Great Salt Lake, with bison, salt beaches and huge sunsets.
